title.zh: 【Polkadot 社区基金会：Fearless Wallet 浏览器插件含泄露私钥代码，用户需立即转移资产】
title.en: 【Polkadot 社区基金会：Fearless Wallet 浏览器插件含泄露私钥代码，用户需立即转移资产】

current_state.zh: Polkadot Community Foundation warned that Fearless Wallet's browser extension (versions 3.0.1–3.0.5) contains malicious code that sends users' private keys to attacker-controlled servers, urging all users since February 2025 to generate new keys and move assets immediately, with 17,286 DOT already reported stolen across eight users.
current_state.en: Polkadot Community Foundation warned that Fearless Wallet's browser extension (versions 3.0.1–3.0.5) contains malicious code that sends users' private keys to attacker-controlled servers, urging all users since February 2025 to generate new keys and move assets immediately, with 17,286 DOT already reported stolen across eight users.

updates.title_zh: 【Polkadot 社区基金会：Fearless Wallet 浏览器插件含泄露私钥代码，用户需立即转移资产】
updates.title_en: 【Polkadot 社区基金会：Fearless Wallet 浏览器插件含泄露私钥代码，用户需立即转移资产】
updates.what_changed_zh:
Polkadot 社区基金会在 Polkadot 论坛发布安全警告称，第三方钱包 Fearless Wallet 浏览器插件的 3.0.1、3.0.3、3.0.4 及 3.0.5 版本含有恶意代码，用户解锁钱包时私钥会被发送至攻击者控制的服务器。该代码于 2025 年 2 月 19 日随一项名为「TON ecosystem」的大型代码变更加入插件公开源码，在 2025 年 2 月至 2026 年 10 月 10 日期间不定时生效，且随时可能被重新启用。

基金会建议，自 2025 年 2 月起使用过该插件的用户应将其中所有账户视为已泄露，立即在其他钱包中生成新密钥对并转移资产，并强调仅更换密码或重装插件无效。目前已有 8 名用户报告了可归因于此事件的未授权交易，共计 17,286 枚 DOT。

Chrome 版本已确认受影响，已下架的 Firefox 版本使用了相同代码；Android 和 iOS 移动端未发现该代码，但若同一私钥曾导入过浏览器插件，同样应视为已泄露。资产处于质押、提名池或治理投票锁定中的用户，可先借助 polkadot-api 团队开发的 PAPI Rescue 工具协助找回。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Polkadot Community Foundation warned that Fearless Wallet's browser extension (versions 3.0.1–3.0.5) contains malicious code that sends users' private keys to attacker-controlled servers, urging all users since February 2025 to generate new keys and move assets immediately, with 17,286 DOT already reported stolen across eight users.
updates.background_zh: Fearless Wallet 是面向 Polkadot 与 Kusama 生态的钱包，同时提供浏览器插件和移动端应用；基金会强调该钱包由独立团队开发维护，并非 Polkadot 官方钱包。PAPI Rescue 自称为面向 Polkadot 生态链上受损钱包的技术恢复服务，会针对每个符合条件的案例调整方案。在 Polkadot 上，用于质押的 DOT 处于绑定锁定状态，这会使从已泄露账户中转出资产的流程更加复杂。
updates.background_en: Fearless Wallet is a Polkadot- and Kusama-focused wallet offered as both a browser extension and a mobile app; the Foundation stressed that it is developed and maintained by an independent team and is not an official Polkadot wallet. PAPI Rescue describes itself as a technical recovery service for compromised wallets on Polkadot-based chains, adapting its product to each eligible case. On Polkadot, staked DOT is bonded and locked, which complicates moving funds out of a compromised account.
updates.market_impact_zh: 风险传导主要经由 Polkadot 生态的自托管与钱包供应链渠道：使用过该插件的 DOT 持有者面临私钥泄露风险，而已报告的 17,286 枚 DOT 损失相对网络规模较小，因此短期市场传导更多体现为受影响用户被迫迁移至其他 Polkadot 钱包，而非广泛的流动性压力。
updates.market_impact_en: The exposure runs through the self-custody and wallet supply-chain channel on Polkadot: DOT holders who used the extension face key compromise, and the reported 17,286 DOT in losses is small relative to network scale, so the immediate market transmission is limited to affected users' forced migrations toward other Polkadot wallets rather than broad liquidity pressure.
